from.place: right adjoint commutes with direct sums: the derived direct image of a perfect object is perfect

title: Perfect direct image along a perfect proper morphism
statement: Let f:X\to Y be a perfect proper morphism of Noetherian schemes [def-pc-scheme] (perfect means finite Tor dimension, equivalently that \mathcal O_X has finite Tor dimension over Y), and let P be a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_X) [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Then Rf_*P [def-pc-derived-direct-image] is a perfect object of D(\mathcal O_Y).
